positions.name: RatifiedAdoptionCommitment
positions.frame: How is the adoption performed as already decided and operationally committed, rather than proposed or under consideration?
positions.why: src-1 declares adoption in present progressive as a settled collective act; src-3 commits the organization to a concrete migration timeline; src-4 ratifies the prior statements as recorded decisions under a summary header. All three perform the decisional stance — the adoption is enacted as concluded, not deliberated. src-2, the performance justification, is a claim supporting the decision but is not itself a ratification; it stays ungrouped.
